shortBio.en: Blur frontman; also builds Gorillaz outside the four-piece logo.
shortBio.zh: Blur 主唱；亦在四人组 logo 外建立 Gorillaz。

whyHub.en: Blur Britpop/art-rock path plus Gorillaz project without bandSlug file.
whyHub.zh: Blur Britpop/art-rock 路径 + 无 bandSlug 文件的 Gorillaz 项目。

body.en:
Born 1968. Character vocals and observational writing on Parklife; later electronic lean on Think Tank. Parallel Gorillaz catalog expands sample/character pop outside Blur.

Hub: same writer, multiple logos.
body.zh:
1968 年生。Parklife 上的角色人声与观察式写作；Think Tank 后期偏电子。并行 Gorillaz 目录在 Blur 外扩展采样/角色流行。

枢纽：同一写手，多个 logo。
